He thought he was winning the hike. Then a stranger flew past him.

Kevin Trudeau was leading a 12-mile hike when a Korean man he hadn't noticed sprinted past him in the last hundred yards. He later learned the man had climbed Mount Everest twice last year.

The man's mindset was simple: your body will say it's tired, but don't listen. Kevin explains that you tell your body what to do.

When did your mind last overrule your body?

#ad #mindset #success #kevintrudeau

A reporter with two degrees asked what qualified him. His answer silenced her.

Kevin Trudeau had just memorized 150 names in a room full of people. She told him he had no college education and asked what qualified him to teach memory.

He asked how many names she could remember with all her degrees. Kevin's point is that it isn't a degree, it's what you do and how you perform.

What can you do that no certificate could prove?

#ad #success #confidence #kevintrudeau
